resources.string: Are you sure you want to close the app?
The app closed while restoring %1$s, so some of it may be missing. Nothing was deleted \u2014 run the same restore again from Settings \u2192 Backup & Restore to fill in the rest.
Choose which playlist to browse. This applies everywhere and is remembered.
Press OK on the poster to view episodes.
Focus a movie to see details.
Focus a channel to see it here.
Press OK to watch fullscreen \u00b7 Long-press for options
Only for this profile. Leave blank to restore the original name.
Focus a series, press OK to view episodes.
Focus an episode to see details.
Already downloaded \u2014 check the Downloads menu.
OK to play \u00b7 long-press for options
Pick a recent program to replay from the start.
No recent guide data for this channel yet \u2014 make sure its EPG is matched (long-press it, or use Match EPG).
Pick a time to start watching from. No guide needed.
Press OK on the day, hour or minute, change it with up and down, then press OK again.
Pick the guide channel for \u201c%1$s\u201d. Current: %2$s
No EPG data yet \u2014 add an EPG source in Settings.
Select a channel to preview it here.
You\'re offline \u2014 playback and updates won\'t work until you reconnect.
%1$s arrives in a later phase. Add an M3U or Xtream source to populate this list.
Movies & episodes saved for offline playback.
No downloads yet. Open a movie or episode and press Download.
That folder is no longer available. Choose it again, or pick another.
Your download folder isn\'t available right now, so downloads are being saved to OwnTV\'s own folder until it\'s back.
Download failed \u2014 couldn\'t reach the source. Tap Retry.
Create a profile to see the guide.
Every channel is hidden by the current filter. Change the sort to see the guide.
Add a playlist to see the guide.
Guide data is stored, but its channel ids don\'t match your channels\' EPG ids \u2014 this EPG feed may belong to a different provider lineup.
Catch-up isn\'t available for this channel.
Matched \u2014 but this guide channel has no current programs in the EPG feed yet.
No EPG data to match against yet.
No EPG match found for \u201c%1$s\u201d \u2014 try picking manually.
Add an EPG (XMLTV) source to fill the guide with programs.
Favorite this channel, or set its guide data.
These channels were matched by name but weren\'t a confident fit. Accept the right ones; skip the rest.
Move right into a row, then browse with \u25c0 \u25b6 to preview a program.
Set a permanent choice in Settings \u203a Catch-up.
Move the guide for “%1$s”. Use this when an East/West feed shares its guide with the other version — a negative offset pulls the guide earlier.
Preview off — your provider allows one stream at a time
